metadata.note: This is a simplified demo rule catalog, not a complete legal implementation of OIML R 76. Final applicability and calculations must be validated against the applicable edition and laboratory procedure.

tests.name: General Examination
tests.description: Visual and functional examination of the instrument, markings and devices.

tests.name: Weighing Performance Test
tests.description: Determination of weighing performance using test loads.

tests.name: Repeatability Test
tests.description: Verification of repeatability under the same conditions and load.

tests.name: Eccentricity Test
tests.description: Determination of error when the load is applied at different positions.

tests.name: Tare Test
tests.description: Verification of tare device functionality and accuracy.

tests.name: Temperature Influence Test
tests.description: Determination of the influence of temperature on the indication.

tests.name: Sensitivity Test
tests.description: Digital discrimination check at Min, half Max, and Max using an additional load of 1.4 times d.

tests.name: Endurance Test
tests.description: Verification of metrological performance after repeated loading cycles.
